summary: ZWHAND is ZHAOWEI's bionic dexterous-hand family for robotic end-effector integration. description.en: ZWHAND is ZHAOWEI's bionic dexterous-hand family for robotic end-effector integration. The manufacturer's presentation combines independent finger-joint motors with fingertip sensing, drawing on its micro-motor, gearbox, encoder and control technologies. It describes 17- or 20-degree-of-freedom configurations for complex grasping, with potential use in humanoids and industrial automation. Because the public presentation covers multiple configurations, a single mass, load rating or joint arrangement is not assigned to the whole family. Exact specifications require matching the selected hand to its corresponding configuration.
